title: The padlock
logline: The mill gate chained and padlocked, 1994, from inside the yard looking out at the beach road, the way the last man out saw it before he turned the key. The keys the sequence is built around are in a hand at the page's edge.

panels.composition: From inside an empty mill yard: the chain-link gate chained and padlocked, the beach road and the bay beyond it, and at the page's right edge a broad man's hand holding two keys on a ring.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, seen from inside an empty mill yard, a chain-link gate chained and padlocked with a beach road and bay beyond, a broad man's hand holding two keys on a ring at the page's edge, no words
